nodes.title: SG-8.4.3 quality gate: REQ-531 context.md module table lists real paths
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md still describes a README-only repo, and the docs helpers (docsCheck.ts, contextDoc.ts) only expose loose pieces. Desired behavior: the module table is checked against the four real paths (game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md, backend/) and the stack names Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest, TypeScript and Go with no UNKNOWN. Expected result: contextStack and context module path unit tests pass. Why: the final docs step must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when the module paths are read, then game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ are all listed and exist on disk
- Given the repo-root context.md, when stack terms and stale text are checked, then no term is missing, no stale README-only text and no UNKNOWN remain


## Scope
- In scope: Checkable helpers for the context.md stack and module table
- In scope: Unit tests for those helpers and for the real context.md
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and the contribution/round API
- Out of scope: New features, content or art changes
- Out of scope: Other SG-8.4 steps
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: No file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- Preserve: game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Preserve: Gameplay unchanged


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- Every step lands green: npm test and npm run typecheck in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src is over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) and the contribution/round API are out of scope


## Definition of done
- Both requirements have Act and Verify units passing
- contextStack, contextPaths and contextDoc suites pass against the regenerated context.md


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md Stack check reports every missing term, stale string and UNKNOWN
nodes.body:
Context: docsCheck.ts has STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT, missingTerms and staleTextHits, but the Go and UNKNOWN rules live only in test regexes. Desired behavior: a single exported contextStackProblems(md) returns every problem. Expected result: the Stack section can be gated by one call. Why: REQ-531 requires the real stack with no placeholders.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a text missing Vitest and Go, when contextStackProblems runs, then it returns 'missing term: Vitest' and 'missing Go'
- Given a text containing hello Worldseed and UNKNOWN, when it runs, then it returns 'stale text: hello Worldseed' and 'UNKNOWN placeholder'
- Given a text with every term, Go and no stale text, when it runs, then it returns []


## Scope
- In scope: New exported function in game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: Changing STACK_TERMS or STALE_TEXT values
- Preserve: Existing exports indexedPaths, missingPaths, missingTerms, staleTextHits keep their behavior


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No source file in game/frontend/src over 200 lines


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- contextStackProblems exported and used by the Verify tests


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists the required real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:
Context: contextDoc.ts returns table paths and docsCheck.missingPaths checks existence, but nothing enforces the four required rows. Desired behavior: contextModuleProblems(md, exists) returns a message per required path absent from the table and per listed path that does not exist. Expected result: the module table is gated by one call. Why: REQ-531.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a table without backend/, when it runs, then it returns 'missing required path: backend/'
- Given a table listing game/ghost/ that exists() rejects, when it runs, then it returns 'path not found: game/ghost/'
- Given all four required paths that exist, when it runs, then it returns []


## Scope
- In scope: New exported function in game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Preserve: contextModulePaths output unchanged


## Technical constraints
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- No source file in game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- contextModuleProblems exported and used by the Verify tests


## Clarifying questions
- None
